description: Source code for training CIFAR10 with differential privacy using PyTorch and Opacus, including model setup, training, testing, and privacy accounting.

methods.name: save_checkpoint
methods.description: Saves training state to a checkpoint file and updates best model checkpoint if applicable.

methods.name: accuracy
methods.description: Calculates the mean accuracy given predictions and labels.

methods.name: train
methods.description: Performs one epoch of training, including forward pass, loss computation, backpropagation, optimizer step, and privacy accounting.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Evaluates the model on the test dataset and computes accuracy.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments, set up data loaders, model, optimizer, privacy engine, and run training and testing over epochs.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for training configuration.
